name: Text Alert
creator: Joshua Ferguson
desc: NanoKVM Go+ only: get notified when a phrase appears on the target's screen (on-device OCR).

NANOKVM_MCP_KEY.label: NanoKVM MCP API key
NANOKVM_MCP_KEY.description: Enable MCP in Settings, then paste the API key shown there.

WATCH_TEXTS.label: Phrases to watch for
WATCH_TEXTS.description: Separated by ';', e.g. Build succeeded; Kernel panic; Installation complete. Case, spaces and punctuation are ignored.

COOLDOWN_MIN.label: Repeat alert after (minutes)
COOLDOWN_MIN.description: Per phrase, so a message that stays on screen alerts once

HA_WEBHOOK_URL.label: Home Assistant webhook URL
HA_WEBHOOK_URL.description: http(s)://<ha>/api/webhook/<id>; payload has title, message, level, device
